name: Grid slice
description: The grid plane of a field file at an index along x, y or z (exact samples; label fields keep their categories), coloured by one component or the magnitude with a scalar bar, plus an outline and axes. Reproduces view.build's 'slice' mode (component 0, middle index by default).

bindings.name: data
bindings.description: The directory (or Runtime task) holding the field file.

graph.name: Grid slice
graph.description: stk.filter.slice (axis mode) -> slice_image layer coloured by a component, with a scalar bar.

parameters.name: path
parameters.label: Field file
parameters.description: Path inside the binding: DAT, NPY, VTI, legacy VTK or VTKHDF.

parameters.name: index
parameters.label: Index
parameters.description: Grid index along the axis (null = the middle).

parameters.name: component
parameters.label: Component
parameters.description: Component index, or "magnitude" (null = the magnitude of a vector field).
